title: Old Man and Three Cats
description: An elderly man wearing a purple beret and glasses sits at a wooden table, resting his chin on his hand while looking at three cats. In a barren, stormy landscape with lightning, three cats sit on the table: a grey one, a green tabby, and a brown one raising its paw, with shadowy uniformed figures visible in the background.
prompt: An elderly man with white hair, glasses, and a purple beret sits at a wooden table in a desolate wasteland, thoughtfully looking at three cats sitting on the table. One grey cat, one green tabby, and one brown cat with a raised paw stare back at him. Dark stormy sky with dramatic lightning, barren ground with bones, and shadowy soldiers in uniform shaking hands in the background, painterly digital art style.
